== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Daughter Of Skywalker (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-daughterofskywalker-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-65-Daughter_Of_Skywalker.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html; ▼ written out there), Advanced Rulebook 2.0 Appendix A and the Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side p. 7. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If in hand, may place her under Reserve Deck. May be targeted instead of Luke by Mind What You Have Learned (that card then targets Leia instead of Luke for remainder of game). May ▼ Reflection. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_63</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
